verses.sloka: ताम् कथाम् कौशिको रामे निवेद्य मधुर अक्षरम् ।पुनः एव अपरम् वाक्यम् काकुत्स्थम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-३८-१॥
verses.transliteration: tām kathām kauśiko rāme nivedya madhura akṣaram ।punaḥ eva aparam vākyam kākutstham idam abravīt ॥1-38-1॥

translations.english: Viswamitra, an offspring of Kusika having related the story (of Karthikeya) to the son of the Kakusthas (Rama) said again.

verses.sloka: अयोध्या अधिपतिः वीरः पूर्वम् आसीत् नराधिपः ।सगरो नाम धर्मात्मा प्रजाकामः स च अप्रजः ॥१-३८-२॥
verses.transliteration: ayodhyā adhipatiḥ vīraḥ pūrvam āsīt narādhipaḥ ।sagaro nāma dharmātmā prajākāmaḥ sa ca aprajaḥ ॥1-38-2॥

translations.english: "In olden days there lived a brave and righteous king named Sagara who was ruler of Ayodhya. He was childless and desired to have children,
translations.hindi: हे ब्रह्मपिं ! आपने पुण्य देने वाली उत्तम कथा कही। अब हिमालय की जेठी बेटी गङ्गा जी की कथा मुझसे कहिए

verses.sloka: वैदर्भ दुहिता राम केशिनी नाम नामतः ।ज्येष्ठा सगर पत्नी सा धर्मिष्ठा सत्य वादिनी ॥१-३८-३॥
verses.transliteration: vaidarbha duhitā rāma keśinī nāma nāmataḥ ।jyeṣṭhā sagara patnī sā dharmiṣṭhā satya vādinī ॥1-38-3॥

translations.english: O Rama the daughter of the king of Vidarbha by name Kesini was Sagara's eldest wife who was righteous and truthful.

verses.sloka: अरिष्ठनेमि दुहिता सुपर्ण भगिनी तु सा ।द्वितीया सगरस्य आसीत् पत्नी सुमति संज्ञिता ॥१-३८-४॥
verses.transliteration: ariṣṭhanemi duhitā suparṇa bhaginī tu sā ।dvitīyā sagarasya āsīt patnī sumati saṁjñitā ॥1-38-4॥

translations.english: The daughter of Arishtanemi named Sumati was the second wife of Sagara and none surpassed her in charm on earth.
translations.hindi: हे धर्मज्ञ ! नदियों में उत्तम गङ्गा का नाम तीनों लोकों में -त्रिपथगा किन-किन कर्मो के कारण हुआ

verses.sloka: ताभ्याम् सह महाराजा पत्नीभ्याम् तप्तवान् तपः ।हिमवंतम् समासाद्य भृगु प्रस्रवणे गिरौ ॥१-३८-५॥
verses.transliteration: tābhyām saha mahārājā patnībhyām taptavān tapaḥ ।himavaṁtam samāsādya bhṛgu prasravaṇe girau ॥1-38-5॥

translations.english: The king (Sagara) accompanied by his wives reached Himavat mountain and engaged himself in severe austerities on a peak called Bhriguprasravana.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र के पूछने पर तपोधन विश्वामित्र जी ने सारा वृत्तान्त ऋषियों के बीच बैठ कर ( इस प्रकार ) कहा

verses.sloka: अथ वर्ष शते पूर्णे तपसा आराधितो मुनिः ।सगराय वरम् प्रादाद् भृगुः सत्यवताम् वरः ॥१-३८-६॥
verses.transliteration: atha varṣa śate pūrṇe tapasā ārādhito muniḥ ।sagarāya varam prādād bhṛguḥ satyavatām varaḥ ॥1-38-6॥

translations.english: When Sagara completed a hundred years in austerities, highly pleased by his performance, ascetic Bhrugu, the best among the truthful granted him a boon.
translations.hindi: र हे राम ! पूर्वेकाल में महातपस्वी महादेव जी का विवाह पार्वती जी के साथ हुआ और वे उनको देख, कामवशवर्ती हो, उनके साथ विहार करने लगे

verses.sloka: अपत्य लाभः सुमहान् भविष्यति तव अनघ ।कीर्तिम् च अप्रतिमाम् लोके प्राप्स्यसे पुरुषर्षभ ॥१-३८-७॥
verses.transliteration: apatya lābhaḥ sumahān bhaviṣyati tava anagha ।kīrtim ca apratimām loke prāpsyase puruṣarṣabha ॥1-38-7॥

translations.english: O sinless one, you will get a very great progeny, O best among men you will acquire unparalleled fame in this world.

verses.sloka: एका जनयिता तात पुत्रम् वंशकरम् तव ।षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि अपरा जनयिष्यति ॥१-३८-८॥
verses.transliteration: ekā janayitā tāta putram vaṁśakaram tava ।ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi aparā janayiṣyati ॥1-38-8॥

translations.english: O child, one wife will beget a son who will perpetuate your race and the other, sixty thousand sons, said Bhrugu.

verses.sloka: भाषमाणम् महात्मानम् राज पुत्र्यौ प्रसाद्य तम् ।ऊचतुः परम प्रीते कृतांजलि पुटे तदा ॥१-३८-९॥
verses.transliteration: bhāṣamāṇam mahātmānam rāja putryau prasādya tam ।ūcatuḥ parama prīte kṛtāṁjali puṭe tadā ॥1-38-9॥

translations.english: Thereafter, both the daughters of the king were exceedingly delighted. Having propitiated that magnanimous asectic both of them with folded hands in supplication, said:

verses.sloka: एकः कस्याः सुतो ब्रह्मन् का बहून् जनयिष्यति ।श्रोतुम् इच्छावहे ब्रह्मन् सत्यम् अस्तु वचः तव ॥१-३८-१०॥
verses.transliteration: ekaḥ kasyāḥ suto brahman kā bahūn janayiṣyati ।śrotum icchāvahe brahman satyam astu vacaḥ tava ॥1-38-10॥

translations.english: O knower of Brahman which of us will beget one, and who many sons? O Brahmarshi we wish to hear. Let your words come true".
translations.hindi: « है देवदेव महादेव ! देवताओं के प्रणाम से प्रसन्न हूजिए ओर इस लोक की रक्षा कीजिए

verses.sloka: तयोः तत् वचनम् श्रुत्वा भृगुः परमधार्मिकः ।उवाच परमाम् वाणीम् स्वच्छन्दो अत्र विधीयताम् ॥१-३८-११॥
verses.transliteration: tayoḥ tat vacanam śrutvā bhṛguḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ।uvāca paramām vāṇīm svacchando atra vidhīyatām ॥1-38-11॥

translations.english: Hearing their words, highly virtuous Bhrugu made an excellent statement saying, 'In this matter, you may exercise your free will'.

verses.sloka: एको वंश करो वा अस्तु बहवो वा महाबलाः ।कीर्तिमन्तो महोत्साहाः का वा कम् वरम् इच्छति ॥१-३८-१२॥
verses.transliteration: eko vaṁśa karo vā astu bahavo vā mahābalāḥ ।kīrtimanto mahotsāhāḥ kā vā kam varam icchati ॥1-38-12॥

translations.english: 'What would you wish? One son who perpetuates the race or many possessed of mighty strength endowed with fame and perseverance?' (asked Bhrugu).
translations.hindi: तीनों लोकों के हित के लिए अपना तेज अपने शारीर ही में रखिए, जिससे तीनों लोकों की रक्षा हो, उनका नाश न कीजिए

verses.sloka: मुनेः तु वचनम् श्रुत्वा केशिनी रघुनंदन ।पुत्रम् वंश करम् राम जग्राह नृप संनिधौ ॥१-३८-१३॥
verses.transliteration: muneḥ tu vacanam śrutvā keśinī raghunaṁdana ।putram vaṁśa karam rāma jagrāha nṛpa saṁnidhau ॥1-38-13॥

translations.english: "O Rama, delight of the descendants of Raghus, on hearing the words of the ascetic in the presence of king Sagara, Kesini chose the boon to have a son who perpetuates the race.
translations.hindi: सर्वलोकों के परम नियन्ता महादेव जी, देवताओं के वचन सुन बोले, बहुत अच्छा । तदनन्तर कहने लगे

verses.sloka: षष्टिम् पुत्र सहस्राणि सुपर्ण भगिनी तदा ।महोत्साहान् कीर्तिमतो जग्राह सुमतिः सुतान् ॥१-३८-१४॥
verses.transliteration: ṣaṣṭim putra sahasrāṇi suparṇa bhaginī tadā ।mahotsāhān kīrtimato jagrāha sumatiḥ sutān ॥1-38-14॥

translations.english: Then, Sumati (the other wife) sister of Suparna (Garuda) obtained the boon of sixty thousand sons endowed with fame and great perseverance.

verses.sloka: प्रदक्षिणम् ऋषिम् कृत्वा शिरसा अभिप्रणम्य च ।जगाम स्व पुरम् राजा सभार्या रघु नन्दन ॥१-३८-१५॥
verses.transliteration: pradakṣiṇam ṛṣim kṛtvā śirasā abhipraṇamya ca ।jagāma sva puram rājā sabhāryā raghu nandana ॥1-38-15॥

translations.english: O son of the Raghus the king along with his wives, having circumambulated saint Bhrugu, bowed his head in reverence, saluted him with folded hands and returned to his capital.
translations.hindi: परन्तु हे देवताओं ! यह तो बतलाओ कि, जो मेरा तेज ( वीय ) स्थानच्युत हो गया हे, उसे कौन धारण करेगा ?

verses.sloka: अथ काले गते तस्मिन् ज्येष्ठा पुत्रम् व्यजायत ।असमंज इति ख्यातम् केशिनी सगरात्मजम् ॥१-३८-१६॥
verses.transliteration: atha kāle gate tasmin jyeṣṭhā putram vyajāyata ।asamaṁja iti khyātam keśinī sagarātmajam ॥1-38-16॥

translations.english: After lapse of some time, the eldest wife Kesini gave birth to a son wellknown by name Asamanjasa.
translations.hindi: नि 6 i NER सग! तब उसमें अग्नि के प्रवेश करने से वह तेज एक स्थान पर ( सिमट कर ) श्वेत पर्वताकार दो गया । फिर अग्नि और सूर्य की तरह चमकीला अति दिव्य सरपत का वन हो गया

verses.sloka: सुमतिः तु नरव्याघ्र गर्भ तुंबम् व्यजायत ।षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि तुंब भेदात् विनिःसृताः ॥१-३८-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sumatiḥ tu naravyāghra garbha tuṁbam vyajāyata ।ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi tuṁba bhedāt viniḥsṛtāḥ ॥1-38-17॥

translations.english: O best among men, Sumati gave birth to a gourdlike foetus and when it burst open, sixty thousand sons emerged.
translations.hindi: यह्‌ सुन महादेव जी ने अपना तेज प्रथिवी पर छोड़ा, जिससे बन-पवेतों सहित प्रथ्वी पूण हो गई

verses.sloka: घृत पूर्णेषु कुंभेषु धात्र्यः तान् समवर्धयन् ।कालेन महता सर्वे यौवनम् प्रतिपेदिरे ॥१-३८-१८॥
verses.transliteration: ghṛta pūrṇeṣu kuṁbheṣu dhātryaḥ tān samavardhayan ।kālena mahatā sarve yauvanam pratipedire ॥1-38-18॥

translations.english: Nurses placed all of them in pots filled with clarified butter and fostered them. They attained adolescence after a long time.
translations.hindi: जब देवताओं को यह मालूम हुआ कि, उस तेज को धारण करने में परध्वी असमर्थ है तव ) बे अग्नि से बोले कि, तुम वायु के साथ इस रुद्र के तेज में प्रवेश करो

verses.sloka: अथ दीर्घेण कालेन रूप यौवनशालिनः ।षष्टिः पुत्र सहस्राणि सगरस्य अभवन् तदा ॥१-३८-१९॥
verses.transliteration: atha dīrgheṇa kālena rūpa yauvanaśālinaḥ ।ṣaṣṭiḥ putra sahasrāṇi sagarasya abhavan tadā ॥1-38-19॥

translations.english: Then, after a long time Sagara's sixty thousand sons attained beauty and youth.

verses.sloka: स च ज्येष्ठो नरश्रेष्ठ सगरस्य आत्म संभवः ।बालान् गृहीत्वा तु जले सरय्वा रघुनंदन ॥१-३८-२०॥
verses.transliteration: sa ca jyeṣṭho naraśreṣṭha sagarasya ātma saṁbhavaḥ ।bālān gṛhītvā tu jale sarayvā raghunaṁdana ॥1-38-20॥

translations.english: O best among men, delight of the Raghus (in the mean time) sagara's eldest son Asamanjasa, used to seize hold of children and throw them into the waters of river Sarayu. And while they were drowning, he was laughing.
translations.hindi: उसी से स्वाभिकात्तिक अग्नि के समान तेजस्वी उत्पन्न हुए । तदनन्तर सब देवताओं और ऋषियों ने उमा और शिव की पूजा 'की

verses.sloka: प्रक्षिप्य प्रहसन् नित्यम् मज्जतस् तान् निरीक्ष्य वै ।एवम् पाप समाचारः सज्जन प्रतिबाधकः ॥१-३८-२१॥
verses.transliteration: prakṣipya prahasan nityam majjatas tān nirīkṣya vai ।evam pāpa samācāraḥ sajjana pratibādhakaḥ ॥1-38-21॥

translations.english: Thus this son inclined towards evil and formenting the good citizens was banished (of the king) from the capital for his indulgence in malevolent acts.
translations.hindi: हे राम ! जब प्रसन्न मन से देवताओं ने पूजन किया, तब उमा ( क्रुद्ध होकर ) देवताओं से बोलीं

verses.sloka: पौराणाम् अहिते युक्तः पित्रा निर्वासितः पुरात् ।तस्य पुत्रो अंशुमान् नाम असमंजस्य वीर्यवान् ॥१-३८-२२॥
verses.transliteration: paurāṇām ahite yuktaḥ pitrā nirvāsitaḥ purāt ।tasya putro aṁśumān nāma asamaṁjasya vīryavān ॥1-38-22॥

translations.english: Asamanjasa's son was Anshuman. He was valiant, beloved and courteous to every one in the world.
translations.hindi: अरे देवताओं, तुमने |जो मेरे लिए अप्रिय काये किया है उसका फल हुम पावोगे । सूर्य के समान दीप्तिमान्‌ उमा ने यह कह कर हाथ में जल लिया और

verses.sloka: सम्मतः सर्व लोकस्य सर्वस्य अपि प्रियम् वदः ।ततः कालेन महता मतिः समभिजायत ॥१-३८-२३॥
verses.transliteration: sammataḥ sarva lokasya sarvasya api priyam vadaḥ ।tataḥ kālena mahatā matiḥ samabhijāyata ॥1-38-23॥

translations.english: O best among men after a long time, a thought came to the mind of Sagara to definitely perform a sacrifice.
translations.hindi: क्रोध के मारे लाल नेत्र कर उन सब देवताओं को यह्‌ शाफ दिया कि तुमने मेरे पुत्र उत्पन्न होने में बाधा डाली है

verses.sloka: सगरस्य नरश्रेष्ठ यजेयम् इति निश्चिता ।स कृत्वा निश्चयम् राजा स उपाध्याय गणः तदा ।यज्ञ कर्मणि वेदज्ञो यष्टुम् समुपचक्रमे ॥१-३८-२४॥
verses.transliteration: sagarasya naraśreṣṭha yajeyam iti niścitā ।sa kṛtvā niścayam rājā sa upādhyāya gaṇaḥ tadā ।yajña karmaṇi vedajño yaṣṭum samupacakrame ॥1-38-24॥

translations.english: O Rama having determined to perform a sacrifice, he (Sagara) versed in the Vedas, started the initiatory rites for the sacrifice in the company of high priests". इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे अष्टात्रिंशस्सर्ग: 2 Thus ends the thirtyeighth sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
